title: Three bond vectors in a plane
statement:
Why is BF₃ nonpolar in the ideal molecular geometry?

[_]{a}

choices: The three B–F bond dipoles cancel.
A central lone pair cancels one bond.
explanations: Trigonal planar symmetry makes their net dipole zero.
An individual B–F bond is polar.
Boron has no central lone pair in this structure.

solution: The three bonds are equivalent. They lie 120° apart. Take their vector sum. Trigonal planar symmetry makes their net dipole zero.
